annotations.title: Send a reviewed AIApply application to the employer

description: Use this only when the connected user has asked for one specific job from their review queue to be applied for, identified by the job_id from list_review_jobs. Approving it spends one application credit and cannot be undone: AIApply writes the application and sends it to the employer. Show the user the job from list_review_jobs and get their explicit go-ahead first, then call again with confirmed=true. AIApply has not written the application yet at this point, so there is nothing to preview. Approving the same job twice is refused rather than repeated. Needs an AIApply account: if the user has not signed in, calling it asks them to sign in or create one. It also needs a permission the user grants; if it was not granted, calling it asks the user to allow it.

confirmed.description: True only after the user has been shown this application and agreed to send it.

name: submit_application

applied.description: True only when the application was sent.

dashboard_url.description: The AIApply dashboard, where the user manages Auto Apply.

error.description: True when the send could not be completed.

found.description: False when no such application belongs to the account.

previous_status.description: Present only on a successful send: the status it was in before.

reason.description: Why nothing was sent, when nothing was.

user_message.description: Show this to the user rather than message.
